question: Does collecting the teacher's demonstrations against a diverse opponent pool change a cloned compact CABT policy's win rate on held-out deck families?

analysis.checkpoint_score: equally weighted mean of the checkpoint's win rates on the two held-out deck families; a draw counts half
analysis.primary_estimate: mean checkpoint score of diverse-opponent-pool minus that of fixed-opponent-pool
analysis.interval: percentile cluster bootstrap that resamples training seeds within each variant
analysis.difference_rule: a difference is reported when the 95% interval excludes zero
analysis.equivalence_rule: equivalence is reported when the 90% interval lies inside plus or minus the margin
analysis.inconclusive_rule: if neither rule holds, the result is reported as inconclusive
secondary: teacher agreement: share of held-out decisions with more than one option where the student's first choice matches the HeuristicAgent teacher, per checkpoint
baselines: heuristic (the teacher), first and random agents scored under the same protocol, with Wilson 95% intervals over games
per-deck and per-opponent win rates, descriptive only
